## TRA Timeline

#### Pre-EDGAR origination and IPO

- 2007-05-25: Original Tax Receivable Agreement executed in connection with Oaktree's 2007 private offering (pre-EDGAR).
- 2008-03-28: First Amended and Restated TRA (pre-EDGAR; superseded in full by the Second A&R).
- 2011-10-20: S-1/A files the form-of Second A&R as Exhibit 10.7.
- 2012-03-29: Second Amended and Restated TRA executed at IPO close.
- 2012-03-30: Final pre-IPO S-1/A files the executed Second A&R as Exhibit 10.7.

#### Brookfield merger restatement

- 2019-09-30: Brookfield merger closes; Third Amended and Restated TRA executed. Brookfield Asset Management Inc. added as Parent. No Tax Benefit Payments on exchanges on or after March 13, 2019; pre-cutoff payments calculated without giving credit for Brookfield's tax attributes.
- 2019-11-07: Q3 2019 10-Q files the executed Third A&R as Exhibit 10.3.
- 2019-10-01: Intermediate Holding Companies merged into Brookfield-side entities; TRA liability for pre-March-13-2019 exchanges transferred off OCG's consolidated balance sheet.

#### LIBOR-to-Benchmark amendment

- 2023-04-13: Amendment to the Third A&R executed; redefines "Agreed Rate" as Applicable Benchmark Rate plus 110 basis points. Filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Q1 2023 10-Q.

#### Pending Fourth A&R

- 2026-04-14: Transaction Agreement among Brookfield Asset Management Ltd., Brookfield Corporation, Brookfield Oaktree Holdings, LLC, OCGH, and Acquisition Z (2026) LP contemplates a Fourth Amended and Restated TRA at Closing; form not yet attached or executed.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Oaktree's May 25, 2007 private offering and was restated at the April 2012 IPO (Second A&R) and again at the September 30, 2019 Brookfield merger close (Third A&R). The Third A&R imposed a March 13, 2019 cutoff so no Tax Benefit Payments accrue on later exchanges, and the residual liability for pre-cutoff exchanges was transferred off OCG's consolidated balance sheet on October 1, 2019 to deconsolidated Brookfield entities. The contract is legally in force; the deferred-CSV cancel signal at 2023-12-31 reflects the accounting reality that no TRA liability appears on the consolidated balance sheet, but the underlying instrument was not terminated. A Fourth Amended and Restated TRA is contemplated by the April 14, 2026 Transaction Agreement (Acquisition Z (2026) LP) but has not been executed or filed. See `contract_log.md` for the full chain-of-title and the manual-verification flag for the pending Fourth A&R.
